gloss: to carry on one's back; to shoulder (a burden)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {背負|せお}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To physically carry something (a backpack, a child, etc.) on one's back. Compound of 背 (back) + 負う (to bear).

definitions.gloss: to shoulder; to bear (a responsibility, debt, burden)
definitions.explanation: To take on or bear a heavy responsibility, debt, or emotional burden. A common figurative extension of the physical meaning.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (う ending, conjugates as w-row: {背負|せお}わない, {背負|せお}います). Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

USAGE:
The figurative sense (shouldering responsibility/burden) is extremely common and often more frequent in everyday use than the physical sense. Also read as しょう in literary contexts ({背負|しょ}う), though せおう is the standard modern pronunciation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{背負|せお}う (to shoulder responsibility)
- ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{背負|せお}う (to bear debt)
- ⟦リュック→リュック：04541_ryukku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{背負|せお}う (to carry a backpack)
- ⟦{十字架|じゅうじか}→十字架：17853_juujika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{背負|せお}う (to bear one's cross)
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{背負|せお}う (to bear one's fate)
